title: Neretva: Neural Variational Inference for Allele-level Genotyping of Highly Polymorphic Genes
description: Neretva genotypes highly polymorphic gene families at the allele level by modelling the problem as a probabilistic latent variable model and performing inference with auto-encoding variational Bayes.
